rec: Necklace of passage to Eagle's Eyrie
rewards: 2 x Rubies (by using a chisel and hammer on the throne)
2 x Emeralds (by using a chisel and hammer on the throne)
2 x Sapphires (by using a chisel and hammer on the throne)
Ability to take the Carpet ride from Shantay Pass to Uzer.

st.t: Talk to the Golem in Uzer to start the quest. A necklace of passage to Eagle's Eyrie is a quick way there.
Use 4 soft clay on the Golem in Uzer.
Pick up the letter on the floor in Uzer and read it.
Enter the Uzer ruins. You can drop the Letter you just read.
Pick up the strange implement in the north west corner of the ruin.
Talk to Elissa in the north east of the Digsite.
s: I found a letter in the desert with your name on.

st.t: Search the bookcase in the south east corner of the Digsite Exam Centre.
Read Varmen's notes.
Talk to Curator Haig in the Varrock Museum. You can drop Varmen's notes.
s: I'm looking for a statuette recovered from the city of Uzer.
I want to open a portal to the lair of an elder-demon.

st.t: Pickpocket Curator Haig for the Display cabinet key.
Go up to the first floor of the Varrock Museum.
Long-press the golem statue's display case and choose Open. It's the second case from the west in the northernmost row.
Enter the Uzer ruins. A necklace of passage to Eagle's Eyrie is a quick way there.
Use the statue on the empty alcove.
Turn each of the statuettes until they all point north, towards the double doors.
Enter the portal.
Leave the throne room through the portal to the south. Then climb back up the stairs you came down to leave the ruins.
Talk to the Golem in Uzer.
Pick up some black mushrooms next to the stairs east of the Golem.
Grind the mushrooms into a vial.
Steal a feather from the desert phoenix north of Uzer. A necklace of passage to Eagle's Eyrie is a quick way there.
Use the phoenix feather on the ink.
Use the phoenix quill on the papyrus.
Use the strange implement on the Golem in Uzer.
Use the golem program on the Golem in Uzer.
